title: Open, close and switch between three projects
as: consultant who works for several clients the same day
goal: Work on three projects one after the other, in the same window and in new windows, without anything from one project showing up in another.
hints: DataPass: Open a Project Repository in a New Window…
expected: Each project opens with its own architecture and tree
The selected variant, work orders and packs of one project never appear in another
Coming back to a project restores its own selected variant
No unhandled error in the extension host log
questions: V01 Clean install: are there activation errors, and how long until the first DataPass view shows?
V02 *Open a Client Project* with an https URL and with an SSH URL, including a private repository without authentication: what happens in each case?
V03 Open, close and switch 3 clients (in the same window and in a new window): does any state leak from one to another (selected variant, work orders, packs)?
V04 Is the selected variant kept after a reload, and is it kept per project?
V05 Are the status bar items still readable at a narrow window width?
V06 Do the webviews render correctly in light, dark and high-contrast themes, and in a narrow panel?
V07 Does each walkthrough step work on a fresh profile?
V08 Which DataPass palette commands fail when there is no context (no project, no file selected)?
V09 After mode switches and then a reload, is the mode and what it shows correct?
V10 AI exchange round trip with Codex as the external AI: does the export → proposal → import loop work?
V11 Hand a work order to the Codex app: does it open in the right folder, and is the receipt detected?
V12 Pilot cards with a stub request: what is shown, and is anything sent?
V13 Editing a bridge JSON file while it is open: how fast do the Problems update, and are the messages readable?
V14 File versions: keep, compare, restore. Is any data lost?
V15 Large workspace: is there any freeze longer than 1 s?
V16 Disable, then uninstall DataPass: does the project still work, and which files are left over?
V17 Git view with no remote, with a detached HEAD, and with worktrees: what does it show?
V18 Toolkit and MCP entries (DataPass 0.27 and later): are they complete and understandable?
V19 Throughout the run: any unhandled error in the extension host log?
